text: The cream is churned sweet, so the buttermilk stays sweet. Aroma starter and a lactic acid concentrate are then worked into the grains, which gives a cultured taste without ripening the cream. The Tetra Pak page gives no amounts or pH.

steps.note: Starter and permeate are mixed into the sweet butter grains.

processing.text: The cream is churned sweet; highly aromatic starter and a lactic acid concentrate (from whey fermented with Lactobacillus helveticus) are worked into the grains, which are aerated to stimulate diacetyl.
